verdict.rationale: Mastra provides a working llms.txt (HTTP 200, verified by probe) plus a docs.md agent-oriented reference, and additionally ships an MCP docs server and embedded package docs specifically designed for AI agents to consume documentation. This directly matches the story's ask for pointing an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: independent third-party confirmation that agents successfully consume these docs in practice (only first-party probes/docs cited).
